// utmpgen A B NOW: writes the w test's utmp records to stdout.
package main

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"net/netip"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

func rec(typ, pid int, line, id, user, host string, sec int64, addr string) []byte {
	b := make([]byte, 384)
	le := binary.LittleEndian
	le.PutUint16(b[0:], uint16(typ))
	le.PutUint32(b[4:], uint32(pid))
	copy(b[8:40], line)
	copy(b[40:44], id)
	copy(b[44:76], user)
	copy(b[76:332], host)
	le.PutUint32(b[336:], uint32(pid))
	le.PutUint32(b[340:], uint32(sec))
	if addr != "" {
		a := netip.MustParseAddr(addr)
		if a.Is4() {
			v := a.As4()
			copy(b[348:], v[:])
		} else {
			v := a.As16()
			copy(b[348:], v[:])
		}
	}
	return b
}

func main() {
	A, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Args[1])
	B, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Args[2])
	now, _ := strconv.ParseInt(os.Args[3], 10, 64)
	var out []byte
	out = append(out, rec(2, 0, "~", "~~", "reboot", "", now-86400*12, "")...)
	out = append(out, rec(7, A, "pts/0", "ts/0", "root", "10.0.0.7", now-300, "10.0.0.7")...)
	out = append(out, rec(7, B, "pts/1", "ts/1", "root", "ws.example.com:0", now-3*86400, "192.168.1.20")...)
	out = append(out, rec(7, A, "pts/0", "ts/0", "bin", "fe80::1%eth0", now-10*86400, "fe80::1")...)
	out = append(out, rec(7, 99999, "pts/5", "ts/5", "root", "gone", now-60, "")...)
	out = append(out, rec(7, B, ":0", ":0", "root", ":0", now-7200, "")...)
	os.Stdout.Write(out)
}
